text:
alex: Quick sync  launching a mini-refapps tutorial sprint + 1 short benchmark card for socials. thinking 3 tiny tutorials (auth, embedding search, rerank) + a 20-min "webinar lite" demo.
riley: love the idea. lightweight = higher conversion. timeline?
alex: target publish: 10 business days. webinar the following week.
tanya: I'll take auth tutorial + set up a tiny sample app. estimate 3 days to draft + 1 day review.
riley: I'll own the embedding search guide and the social benchmark card. want a single headline stat (latency up to X% faster) + link to notebook.
riley: we should be careful with absolute % claims. make it clear "example setup" and include testbed.
ben: i'll do rerank tutorial and a short code snippet for quickstart. also happy to record a 6-min explainer for the webinar.
i18n-bot: Reminder: Add locale files to /i18n/refapps. Default: en. Suggested extras: es, zh.
tanya: can we crowdsource translations? we can add a TRANSLATION_README and a labels.csv for contributors. 48-72hr turnaround target per language.
alex: yes. community translations + small bounty for reviewers. tanya, can you draft the README?
tanya: yep. will add instructions and a sample PR template.
riley: benchmarks: I'll run two configs: hosted small (cpu+gpu mix) and dedicated (gpu pool). three workloads: chat->qa, embed index, rerank. will include cost/sample and p50/p95 latency.
riley: reproducible command i'll include: ```bash
python microbench.py --model redwood-small-quant --batch 4 --seq 256 --workloads chat,embed,rerank --out results.json
```
ben: for the social card, aim for two variants: "developer" (tech stat + OK callout) and "product" (what it enables). alex can pick.
alex: good. messaging: we need three copy tracks: developer-first, product-outcome, and community-invite. riley draft dev copy, ben product copy, tanya community blurbs. jamie can do final polish (cc:jamie).
tanya: inbound routing: can we tag registrants with "mini-refapp-2024" and add an interest flag "want-local-deploy"?
ben: CRM webhook? who sets it up? alex: i'll request a new list in Marketo and set a webhook.
i18n-bot: New task created: i18n/refapps/strings.csv with headers: key, en, notes.
riley: PR checklist for each tutorial: 1) short intro, 2) 5-min quickstart, 3) full repo link, 4) benchmark note, 5) translation-ready strings.
tanya: also add a CONTRIBUTING_TRANSLATIONS.md with examples of phrasing to preserve.
ben: webinar plan: 20-25min demo + 10min q&a. structure: 1) 3x refapps overview (2min each) 2) quick live demo 3) benchmark highlights 4) how to contribute translations 5) Q&A.
riley: recording: i'll capture terminal + slides. keep one demo reproducible step so folks can follow along.
alex: assign owners recap: riley=bench + embed tutorial + dev copy; tanya=auth tutorial + i18n docs + community copy; ben=rerank tutorial + webinar recording + product copy; alex=project lead + marketo webhook. Deadline: publish by 1754100000 (approx 10 days).
tanya: small ask: can we do a 48hr soft-launch to 20 community members to get translation/clarity feedback? helps surface confusing steps.
alex: yes, invite the usual contributors list and give them a small form to report issues.
i18n-bot: New contributor sign-up: https://forms.redwood.ai/refapp-trans-join created.
riley: let's A/B test two email subject lines for registrants: "Try 3 mini refapps: fast guides + demo" vs "Build search with embeddings & rerank in 20 minutes"
ben: also prepare an evergreen 1-pager to attach in follow-up emails (recap + links).
alex: follow-up cadence: day 0 send recording + 1-pager + repo; day 7 send top tips + community translation link; day 21 send a short survey + ask about next tutorials. ben you own the 1-pager.
tanya: i'll prep the translations label bundle so it's easy to import.
riley: final note: include an explicit "testbed & constraints" section in every tutorial and the benchmark card to avoid misinterpretation.
alex: perfect. next check-in Wednesday 10am PT. I'll drop tasks into Asana and ping owners.
